Your own server on your PC (tools/lyrics-server in AMRI\'s repository). The unit asks LRCLIB first, then your server: Megalobiz, NetEase and Musixmatch for timed lyrics, and Genius last for plain ones.\nSync lyrics by listening (off until you turn it on): while a Bluetooth song whose lyrics have no timing plays on the music screen, the car\'s microphone listens to it and sends what it hears to your server only, which writes down the sung words with their times, times the lines and deletes the sound. A song on the unit is sent once as its file instead. Never during calls, while the assistant listens, or while reversing. Timed lyrics are kept, so the next play is timed at once.
